title: Lely's Droom
excerpt: An immersive audiovisual experience inside the Oosterlanderkerk, telling the story of Cornelis Lely and the Afsluitdijk.
description:
Lely's Droom is a fifteen minute immersive experience in the Oosterlanderkerk in Oosterland, Wieringen, made for Erfgoedspektakel and shown through May 2025. Using 3D projection and light across the whole interior, it follows the engineer Cornelis Lely, from the flood in the Anna Paulownapolder to the building of the Afsluitdijk.
> A church is already built for stories that are bigger than the room. Turning its walls and vaults into water and land put the visitor inside the thing Lely spent his life arguing for, rather than in front of a picture of it.
credits: Projection and immersive design: Jaco Schilp. Produced by Erfgoedspektakel at the Oosterlanderkerk, Oosterland, Wieringen, 2025. Initiated by BOEi, with Gemeente Hollands Kroon, Culturele Kring Wieringen and the VriendenLoterij.
